title: In Vitro Analysis of Hemocyte-Derived Extracellular Traps in Shrimp
author: Morales-Covarrubias, Ramírez-Azpilcueta, et al.

steps.title: Prepare bacterial inoculum
steps.instruction: Grow Vibrio parahaemolyticus and adjust to ~1 × 10⁸ CFU mL⁻¹ for use in stimulation.

substeps.instruction: Inoculate a single colony of Vibrio parahaemolyticus strain M0904 into 10 mL Tryptic Soy Broth supplemented with 2 % NaCl (TSB+ Bioxon) in a 15 mL culture tube; shake at 30 °C for 24 h.
Spin the culture at 2000 × g for 20 min at 20 °C, discard supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in 2 % NaCl until the optical density at 600 nm reaches ~1.0 (≈1 × 10⁸ CFU mL⁻¹, 0.5 McFarland).

steps.title: Prepare hemocyte monolayer and stimulate
steps.instruction: Create a hemocyte monolayer on a glass slide, expose it to live Vibrio, and allow extracellular trap formation.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 100 µL of hemocyte suspension (1 × 10⁶ cells mL⁻¹) onto an uncoated glass slide and spread uniformly with a pipette tip.
Incubate the slide for 30 min at 25 °C to permit cell adhesion.
Remove unattached cells by immersing the slide in a container filled with MAS for 1 min.
Add 100 µL of the bacterial inoculum (1 × 10⁸ CFU mL⁻¹ live V. parahaemolyticus M0905) onto the hemocyte monolayer.
Incubate for 3 h at 25 °C to stimulate hemocytes and induce extracellular trap (ET) release.
Remove the bacterial suspension by immersing the slide in MAS for 1 min.

steps.title: Fix and DAPI‑stain cells
steps.instruction: Fix the monolayer, permeabilize, stain DNA with DAPI, and prepare slides for fluorescence microscopy.

substeps.instruction: Cover the slide with 3.7 % formaldehyde in distilled water and fix for 10 min at room temperature (RT).
Wash cells three times with 1 × PBS, 5 min each wash at RT.
Permeabilize cells with 0.01 % Triton X‑100 for 5 min at RT.
Wash cells three times with 1 × PBS, 5 min each wash at RT.
Add enough 300 nM DAPI solution to fully cover the cells.
Incubate for 5 min protected from light.
Wash cells three times with 1 × PBS, 5 min each wash at RT.
Place a cover slip on the slide; keep slides in the dark (e.g., slide box) from this point onward.
Slides are ready for fluorescence microscopy (excitation/emission 358/461 nm).
